3. ALPR Data Sharing report in Axon.

The report should include data logged from the period of January 1, 2025, to the date this request is processed. Per Axon's documentation, the ALPR Data Sharing report is available within the LPR > ALPR Search > LPR Audit menu. You can find instructions to locate this here: https://www.axon.com/help/fusus/software/fusus/alpr/alpr-audit.htm

4. ALPR Hotlist Management Audit report in Axon.

The report should include data logged from the period of January 1, 2025, to the date this request is processed. Per Axon's documentation, the ALPR Hotlist Management Audit report is available within the LPR > ALPR Search > LPR Audit menu. You can find instructions to locate this here: https://www.axon.com/help/fusus/software/fusus/alpr/alpr-audit.htm

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

William Beckett

title: Subject: Records Request—Tony Von Carruthers’ Account of a Proposed Chest Procedure

communications.subject: Tennessee Public Records Act Request: Subject: Records Request—Tony Von Carruthers’ Account of a Proposed Chest Procedure
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Tennessee Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Subject: Records Request—Tony Von Carruthers’ Account of a Proposed Chest Procedure

To Governor Bill Lee’s Office:

According to Tony Von Carruthers, Kenneth Nelson, identified as a TDOC warden, instructed Dr. Mark Walton Fowler to cut open Carruthers’ chest. I am requesting records held by your office that could help establish what occurred and what your office knew.

Please provide:

1. Communications concerning this reported instruction or proposed procedure, including correspondence with TDOC, Nelson, or Fowler.
2. Reports, briefings, or other records received concerning Carruthers’ medical treatment and this account.
3. Records documenting when your office learned of this matter and any response, referral, or review.
4. Communications addressing the procedure’s purpose, medical necessity, authorization, and Carruthers’ consent.

I also ask Governor Lee to seek an independent review of Carruthers’ account and explain what steps his office will take.

Please provide responsive records electronically. If records are withheld, identify the basis and release all portions that can be disclosed. If access requires Carruthers’ authorization, please provide instructions.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 7 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Kent Hoover, a citizen of Tennessee, in coordination with Donald R. Askew Jr..

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Tennessee Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Title: Records Request—Reported Instruction to Cut Open Tony Von Carruthers’ Chest

To the Tennessee Department of Correction:

According to Tony Von Carruthers, Kenneth Nelson, identified as a TDOC warden, instructed Dr. Mark Walton Fowler to cut open Carruthers’ chest.

I request existing records concerning this reported instruction, including:

1. Communications involving Nelson, Fowler, or other personnel about the proposed procedure.
2. Medical orders, consent forms, procedure notes, and records documenting whether the procedure was attempted or performed.
3. Incident reports, staff logs, and internal reviews concerning this account.
4. Policies governing authorization and consent for such a procedure.
5. Records identifying the personnel involved and their roles.

Please provide records explaining the purpose of the proposed procedure, who authorized it, and whether Carruthers gave consent. This request seeks documentation to establish what occurred.

Please provide records electronically. If any portion is withheld, identify the basis for withholding and release all portions that can be disclosed. If medical records require Carruthers’ authorization, please provide the required form and submission instructions.

Sincerely,
Donald Askew Jr.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 7 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Kent Hoover, a citizen of Tennessee, in coordination with Donald R. Askew Jr..
